svg.title: What each OpenBMC program does
svg.text: What each OpenBMC program does: what it watches, what it publishes, what it changes
One card per program running on our BeagleBone. File paths and object paths come from the programs themselves (strings in our image's binaries) and their unit files.
PUBLISHES on D-Bus: objects others can read/set
the second line of each card = the D-Bus name it claims

svg.text: How they fit together (read a card, then follow the arrows in your head)

text.tspan: From outside, requests arrive through bmcweb (web/Redfish), IPMI, or you over SSH (busctl, obmcutil). They become D-Bus calls to the program that owns that job.
Programs find each other through the
, then talk directly (via dbus-broker). None of them stores anything in D-Bus itself.
that the state managers start (see the targets cheat sheet); the state managers then report the result.
Anything that must survive a reboot is in that program's own file (
